nodes.label: Knowledge Graph / Obsidian Vault Workflow
nodes.rationale: Explore the project through graphify queries and the Obsidian vault before reading source files, to cut token usage; refresh the graph and vault after every code or doc change so the vault never goes stale.

nodes.label: Task Runner Rules (Mise vs Bun)
nodes.rationale: Infrastructure and database lifecycle belong to Mise; all application workflows (dev, build, test) go through Bun tasks in root package.json. Invoke as `bun run <task>` because bare `bun <task>` collides with Bun built-ins.

nodes.label: Build Environment (.NET SDK 10)
nodes.rationale: Host has SDK 9 globally and SDK 10 only in ~/.dotnet, so DOTNET_ROOT must be set for host builds; container builds are preferred.

nodes.label: Closure Model Replaces Camp Sessions
nodes.rationale: A Closure is a date range in which the whole center (RoomId null) or one room is unavailable; it replaced the earlier fixed camp-session (turnus) model so bookings can span arbitrary date ranges.

nodes.label: GiST Exclusion Constraint Against Double Booking
nodes.rationale: btree_gist exclusion on (RoomId, daterange[StartDate,EndDate)) enforces non-overlap at the database level; half-open ranges let a checkout and a check-in share a day without colliding.

nodes.label: Security Requirements
nodes.rationale: Bcrypt passwords, refresh-token rotation with reuse detection, per-IP rate limiting, server-side amount computation, and SHA-384-verified idempotent P24 webhooks.
